Block.description: Discriminated by ``kind``; validators enforce exactly one payload shape.
Block.title: Block

CellFormula.description:
Spreadsheet formula with its cached result.

The cached value is what a reader sees without recalculation; it must agree
with the cell's typed ``value`` so a formula can never disagree with the
semantic fact the cell references.
CellFormula.title: CellFormula

ColumnSpec.description:
Column-level type is an *expectation*, never a coercion (DEC-11).

Cell values are authoritative.  A homogeneous column may declare its type;
a heterogeneous column declares ``mixed``; leaving it ``None`` also means no
expectation.  Typed cells that disagree with a concrete declaration are
rejected rather than converted.
ColumnSpec.title: ColumnSpec

CorpusWorld.description: Layer-1 aggregate: every semantic object in one corpus, keyed by id.
CorpusWorld.title: CorpusWorld

CrossReference.description: A typed link between documents, optionally between specific facts.
CrossReference.title: CrossReference

InlineRun.description: A run of text, optionally anchored to an entity, document or typed value.
InlineRun.title: InlineRun

IsoDate.description: A date with explicit precision; inconsistent precision is rejected, not repaired.
IsoDate.title: IsoDate

MessageMeta.description: Per-message thread linkage (decision DEC-7); the thread itself is Layer 1.
MessageMeta.title: MessageMeta

Money.description: Exact monetary amount in minor units.  ``Money(400_000_000, "GBP")`` is £4,000,000.
Money.title: Money

SemanticFact.description: A relationship (edge) or a statement (proposition), corpus-scoped.
SemanticFact.title: SemanticFact

Thread.description: Correspondence thread (decision DEC-7).  Messages stay separate documents.
Thread.title: Thread

TimeScope.description: Temporal extent attached to a fact.  Values are typed, never free text.
TimeScope.title: TimeScope

description: One corpus: the semantic world plus every document that states it.
title: Corpus
